style: dynamic shonen anime key visual, bold ink lines, cel shading, intense saturated colors, dramatic lighting, speed lines, Polynesian setting, no text, no letters

Manu.description: Manu, 16 year old Tahitian boy, short messy black hair, tan brown skin, sharp determined eyes, white tank top, red pareo shorts, a dark Polynesian tatau tattoo of shark teeth patterns on his right arm and shoulder

Kahu.description: Kahu, 16 year old chubby Tahitian boy, curly hair, round face, big nervous smile, yellow floral shirt

Vaimiti.description: Vaimiti, 17 year old Polynesian girl warrior from Bora Bora, long black braid, confident smirk, blue and white warrior outfit, glowing blue manta ray tatau on her back

Maʻo.description: Maʻo, a colossal ghostly tiger shark spirit made of dark water and glowing red tatau patterns, burning red eyes

scenes.image: Faa'a Tahiti at sunset seen from above, small houses with tin roofs, the lagoon and Moorea island on the horizon, a plane taking off
scenes.texte: À Tahiti, certains naissent avec un tatau. Un jour, il s'éveille… et donne la force d'un esprit.

scenes.image: {Manu} sitting alone on a concrete wall at dusk in Faa'a, staring at the dull grey tatau on his arm, sad, planes in the orange sky
scenes.texte: Mais celui de Manu, seize ans, ne s'est jamais réveillé. Ici, tout le monde l'appelle : le toa vide.

scenes.image: {Kahu} sitting next to {Manu} on a wall, Kahu putting a hand on Manu's shoulder and smiling, warm evening light, friendship
scenes.texte: Laisse-les parler, Manu. Moi je sais que t'es un vrai toa. Un jour, ton tatau va se réveiller, tu vas voir !

scenes.image: a small traditional Tahitian family house fare at night with a single warm light, an official eviction letter on a wooden table in the foreground, dramatic shadows
scenes.texte: Ce soir-là, une lettre arrive. Si la famille ne paie pas, elle perdra son fare.

scenes.image: {Manu} clenching his fist with determination in front of his family house at night, wind in his hair, low angle heroic shot
scenes.texte: Il y a un seul moyen. Le Tournoi des Toa, à Taputapuātea. Le vainqueur gagne de quoi sauver notre maison.

scenes.image: {Kahu} panicking with wide eyes and arms in the air, comedic anime expression, sweat drops, night
scenes.texte: T'es fou ?! Là-bas, il y aura Vaimiti, la raie manta de Bora Bora ! Elle n'a jamais perdu un seul combat !

scenes.image: {Manu} training alone on a black sand beach at night in the rain, punching through crashing waves, splashes, moonlight
scenes.texte: Chaque nuit, Manu s'entraîne face aux vagues. Mais son tatau reste muet.

scenes.image: deep dark underwater abyss, the gigantic silhouette of {Maʻo} emerging from the darkness toward the viewer, a tiny boy floating in front of it, ominous
scenes.texte: Une nuit, épuisé, il tombe dans l'eau… et quelque chose l'attend dans les profondeurs.

scenes.image: extreme close-up of the burning red eyes and huge teeth of {Maʻo} underwater, glowing red tatau patterns on its skin
scenes.texte: Tu veux ma force, petit ? Elle a un prix. Je dévore aussi celui qui me porte.

scenes.image: {Manu} bursting out of the ocean at night, gasping, his arm tatau now glowing bright red-orange like fire, water splashing, epic
the ancient stone marae of Taputapuātea on Raiatea at dawn, crowd of Polynesian warriors gathering, flags and drums, misty sacred atmosphere
scenes.texte: Quelques semaines plus tard. Marae de Taputapuātea. Le Tournoi des Toa commence.

scenes.image: {Vaimiti} standing on a stone platform, arms crossed, smirking down at the viewer, a giant glowing blue manta ray spirit behind her, dawn light
scenes.texte: Alors c'est toi, le toa vide ? Rentre chez toi avant de te faire mal.

scenes.image: {Manu} in a fighting stance, his tatau blazing red, the ghostly shape of a giant tiger shark spirit behind him, speed lines, epic low angle shot
scenes.texte: Je suis pas vide. Je suis Manu, de Faa'a. Et je suis venu gagner.

scenes.image: a shark tooth necklace glowing red on a black volcanic rock under a stormy sky, Polynesian tatau patterns glowing around it
